author: Reuters
description:
Trump says noncitizen voting is a widespread Democratic plot to influence elections. A Reuters data analysis reveals a far different picture: a small number of often inadvertent violations. Investigative reporter Peter Eisler says that of the 129 prosecutions under the 1996 "voting by aliens" statute, there were no allegations of noncitizens participating in a broader conspiracy to influence election outcomes.
